junior.ownership_style: Focus on specific tickets, paired debugging, learning from code reviews, and execution accuracy without claiming org-wide architecture.
junior.confidence_calibration: Earnest, grounded, comfortable naming what teammates or seniors guided.

mid.ownership_style: Own features, services, on-call troubleshooting, and concrete trade-offs within a team scope.
mid.confidence_calibration: Practical and hands-on, explains config/code choices clearly.

senior.ownership_style: Own multi-service architecture, ambiguity resolution, reliability trade-offs, mentoring, and measurable technical impact.
senior.confidence_calibration: Calm, concise, leads with constraints and trade-offs rather than textbook definitions.

staff.ownership_style: Drive cross-team technical strategy, systemic bottlenecks, build-vs-buy trade-offs, and technical risk alignment.
staff.confidence_calibration: High signal density, bridges implementation reality with business consequences.

principal.ownership_style: Shape company-wide architecture standards, multi-quarter platform bets, and high-stakes technical reversals.
principal.confidence_calibration: Measured, direct about second-order effects and organizational constraints.

manager.ownership_style: Distinguish direct leadership (hiring, prioritization, unblocking, incident governance, accountability) from team execution.
manager.confidence_calibration: Balances people/delivery pragmatism with credible technical grounding.

director.ownership_style: Own multi-team execution, budget/headcount trade-offs, cross-org alignment, and operational reliability posture.
director.confidence_calibration: Outcome-oriented, concise, fluent in both engineering risk and executive priorities.

executive.ownership_style: Own business strategy, P&L/ROI trade-offs, organizational capability building, and board/customer risk posture.
executive.confidence_calibration: Crisp, strategic, drills into technical specifics only when probed.
